title: Backups: restore your work and prove independence
goal: Dump a DT, restore only into a new base and compare two requests before and after changing the copy.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 5; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: A backup contains state
paragraphs: A configuration export describes the solution but is not a full copy of customer documents. An infobase dump preserves data with configuration in its supported format. Copying an open file directory can be inconsistent. Choose a supported method and ensure the required absence of active writes.

Create own customer/service Контроль A6 and two requests of 30 and 45 minutes. Record actual codes, numbers, dates, statuses and the 75-minute control. Retain earlier work; the entire-base total may exceed 75. CF represents configuration; a DT is used to transfer infobase state including data.

sections.title: Controls around recovery
paragraphs: Compare the same own set rather than all earlier work.

code.source:
Source: R1=30, R2=45 → 75
New base from DT: 30+45 → 75
Change the copy only: 45+45 → 90
code.output: Fresh reads show source 75 and separate-copy90.

sections.title: A file is not a verified restore
paragraphs: Creating a backup file does not prove usability. Restore it into a fresh empty directory, open it and reconcile identities, count, totals and configuration version. File size or extension alone cannot detect the wrong source or a logically incomplete copy.

Close Enterprise and use Designer’s normal infobase dump into a new DT. Record path, time and versions. Copying an actively modified 1CD is not a substitute for this checked route. File existence alone does not establish recovery: opening a separate restored target is required.

sections.title: The source is never the target
paragraphs: Record source and fresh destination paths before the operation. If the destination exists, choose another; never erase it automatically. After restore, change the copy to 90 minutes and reread the 75-minute source. This proves independent working instances rather than two shortcuts to one infobase.

Create a new empty infobase without configuration using a new name and directory. Restore replaces the selected target’s contents, so verify its actual path and absence of work first. Never test a dangerous overwrite on your only source; stop such a case before execution.

sections.title: Two labels, one directory
paragraphs: Renaming a list entry does not copy data.

code.source: Source and Copy entries point to the same directory.
code.output: They are one instance; stop before changing it.

tables.caption: Step-by-step reasoning
rows: A separate new base is needed.

sections.title: Rejection also needs a protocol
paragraphs: A damaged or unsuitable file should produce explicit rejection. Do not repair the only backup in place or test it by overwriting work. Preserve a file copy, a safe error classification and unchanged source. A recovery plan also identifies storage, acceptable loss of recent changes and responsibility for verification.

Verify both restored requests and 75, then change only the first copy request from 30 to 45. Its set becomes 90; the source must retain 30/45 and 75. Two list entries pointing to one directory are not independent copies. If verification fails, retain the DT and both states for diagnosis rather than overwrite the only archive.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: CF is treated as a backup of all requests. Use DT and verify the restored application records.
DT is restored over the only working base. Create and verify a new empty target first.
Different names are taken as proof of independence. Compare directories and reread the source after modifying the copy.

selfcheck.prompt: A DT without opening its target means
Specify acceptable recent-change loss and regular restore verification.
selfcheck.feedback: Frequency, storage/access, controls and responsibility specified without treating an untested archive as a guarantee.

practice.title: Source 75, separate restored copy 90
practice.task: Specify acceptable recent-change loss and regular restore verification.
practice.environment: Own original service desk; synthetic records only. No real Nexus accounts, Windows identities or external services are changed.
practice.externalRoute: Official installed 1C Enterprise/Designer of your own separate training copy

steps.title: Prepare own controls
steps.action: Save own Контроль A6 customer/service and two 30/45 requests with Новая. Record actual keys and 75, retaining older records.
steps.troubleshooting: For a repeat attempt reuse the identified pair rather than silently duplicate it.
steps.before: Earlier A5 work/provenance and a verified separate-copy route are retained.

steps.title: Dump infobase state
steps.where: Close Enterprise → Designer → Administration → Dump infobase
steps.action: Choose a new DT in your study folder, finish the dump and record path/time/versions. Keep the earlier archive.
steps.why: Use the normal configuration-and-data backup route.
steps.troubleshooting: A failed dump is not a completed backup.

steps.title: Create an empty target
steps.action: Choose no configuration, a new teaching name and a new empty directory. Compare its path with the source before opening target Designer.
steps.expected: A separate empty base is identified.
steps.troubleshooting: Stop if paths match; a different display name is insufficient.

steps.title: Restore only the empty target
steps.action: Recheck empty-target name/path, choose your DT and confirm replacement of only that target. Wait for completion and open its Enterprise.
steps.troubleshooting: Never confirm replacing the source or any base containing work.
steps.before: A separate empty base is identified.

steps.title: Compare and change only the copy
steps.action: Reread both requests and 75. In the copy change first 30 → 45, save and reread 90. Close it, open the original path and verify 30/45=75.
steps.troubleshooting: If the source also changed, inspect paths and preserve both states before any further changes.

cases.label: Observation 3
cases.output: A separate empty base is identified.

criteria: Application design and stored records distinguished.
Separate paths, actual numbers and fresh reads; earlier work intact.
Frequency, storage/access, controls and responsibility specified without treating an untested archive as a guarantee.
Actual versions and distinct own-copy paths; synthetic identities and before/after values.
Allowed/refused cases, completed controls and explicit untested scope; no secrets.
Use the second worked case to identify the unsafe or unproved condition. Never perform destructive restoration over existing work.
